candidate_basis: 65edba6 plus benchmark instrumentation only; final candidate commit recorded in reports
production_scope: Audit the entire python/src tree. No shared kernel/native/core source change is expected; remeasure all maintained fixed-reference paths regardless.
images: Unchanged original UHD tensile reference.png and frame_040.png. Native/Python-browser runs alternate these actual arrays. PWA acquisition is the original reference as static fake 60Hz camera, with identity truth; never a physical-camera or changing-motion claim.
configuration: 3840x2160, affine16/16, B-spline, two fixed levels, median, uniform, zero initialization, no temporal prediction/fine correction/divergence, existing 8/16 iterations and 0.005 tolerances, no ROI
reference: First image prepared once, immutable throughout each sequence. Cold setup measured separately.
python_boundaries: Resident uint8 NumPy image to complete NumPy field/statistics; native hardware explicitly selected; Python browser includes binary loopback transport. No PNG or acquisition in this boundary.
pwa_boundaries: Separate computed replies from committed IndexedDB fields and Worker-arrival-to-storage-cache-admission latency. Both versions receive the same lightweight storage probe and a Worker epoch metadata field; no GPU fence or shader instrumentation.
ownership_gates: No unsaved field or storage failure; final drain empty; candidate queue at most two CPU slots. Full numerical dimensions regardless of preview.
nonregression_rule: For each backend/boundary/recording case, derive each metric tolerance from the full observed range of its four baseline repeats only, before judging the candidate. Candidate default is checked against baseline median plus/minus that range; FPS also allows 2/20 field-count boundaries for PWA. Report both candidate repeats. One exceedance is inconclusive; two worse exceedances flag reproducible regression. Do not use candidate measurements to widen tolerances. Short runs establish no thermal statistics or hard deadline guarantee.
60fps_rule: Report sustained throughput and p95/p99 latency separately. Throughput >=60 is not sufficient for a 16.67ms latency claim. No weaker numerical settings or reduced input may be used to reach the rate.
isolation: No tests/builds during timing. Linux Intel Lunar Lake, actual driver/browser/software versions and performance power profile recorded; no all-OS/all-GPU claim. Retain all samples and failures.
